papers.title: Toward Reliable Evaluation of LLM-Based Financial Multi-Agent Systems: Taxonomy, Coordination Primacy, and Cost Awareness
papers.key_finding: Coordination protocol design is the primary driver of multi-agent trading quality (exceeds model scaling). Documents 5 pervasive evaluation failures (look-ahead, survivorship, overfitting, transaction cost neglect, regime-shift blindness) that can reverse reported return signs. Introduces Coordination Breakeven Spread (CBS) metric.

papers.title: Toward Expert Investment Teams: A Multi-Agent LLM System with Fine-Grained Trading Tasks
papers.key_finding: Fine-grained task decomposition (explicit workflow steps) significantly improves risk-adjusted returns vs coarse-grained multi-agent instructions on Japanese stock backtests. Same Oxford/Zohren group as DeePM.

papers.title: Cross-Stock Predictability via LLM-Augmented Semantic Networks
papers.key_finding: 10-K embedding graph + LLM edge classification (supply chain / competitor / customer relations) improves L/S Sharpe 0.742→0.820, MaxDD -10.47%→-7.85% on S&P 500 2011-2019. Directly replaces failed cointegration pair selection (H307).

papers.title: SAE-FiRE: Enhancing Earnings Surprise Predictions Through Sparse Autoencoder Feature Selection
papers.key_finding: Sparse Autoencoder decomposition of FinBERT dense representations + ANOVA F-test feature selection significantly outperforms baseline FinBERT on earnings call transcripts, 10Q reports, and financial news. Addresses the curse of dimensionality in 5,000+ word financial documents.

papers.title: DeePM: Regime-Robust Deep Learning for Systematic Macro Portfolio Management
papers.key_finding: Structured DL portfolio manager with Causal Sieve (ragged filtration), Macroeconomic Graph Prior, and Distributionally Robust Objective achieves ~2x net risk-adjusted returns vs conventional, ~+50% vs Momentum Transformer on 50 futures 2010-2025. Code available.

papers.title: Extracting the Structure of Press Releases for Predicting Earnings Announcement Returns
papers.key_finding: Structured press release parsing (guidance 40%, summary 35%, CEO quote 15%, revenue tables 10%) outperforms flat full-document FinBERT. Press release soft information = earnings surprise hard information in predictive power. 138,000+ press releases 2005-2023. Already staged 2026-07-06 as H372.

papers.title: LLM as a Risk Manager: LLM Semantic Filtering for Lead-Lag Trading in Prediction Markets
papers.key_finding: Granger causality + LLM semantic re-ranking of lead-lag pairs outperforms pure Granger screening. Semantic filtering most valuable during large leader moves. Tested on Kalshi prediction markets (not traditional equities — transferability uncertain).

papers.title: Deep Learning for Financial Time Series: A Large-Scale Benchmark of Risk-Adjusted Performance
papers.key_finding: Large-scale benchmark across LSTM, Transformer, SSM, PatchTST on daily futures 2010-2025. Models with rich temporal representations consistently outperform linear benchmarks on Sharpe optimization. Same Oxford group as DeePM. Code available.
papers.note: Supporting reference, lower priority — add to DeePM wiki page as related work

papers.title: Re-evaluating Short- and Long-Term Trend Factors in CTA Replication: A Bayesian Graphical Approach
papers.key_finding: Dynamically decomposes CTA returns into short-term trend, long-term trend, and market beta via Bayesian graphical model. Medium-term horizon (6-12m) has long been most effective. No skip-month analysis — does not directly address H377 6-0m finding.
papers.note: Useful context for H377 literature section but not actionable

papers.title: Predicting Stock Price Direction on Earnings Announcement Days using Multi-modal Deep Learning
papers.key_finding: LSTM + Transformer on 15 fundamental metrics + 3 price indicators + FinBERT news sentiment. Transformer superior recall for volatile movements. LSTM higher precision (conservative safe-bet). May 2026.
papers.note: Lower novelty — similar approach to existing H317 attempts; FinBERT news (not 8-K) is the signal source

skip_month_note: No academic paper found specifically validating the 6-0m > 6-1m finding on US large-cap equities. The H376/H377 finding (OOS 3.120 on 6-0m) is endogenous to the pipeline. arXiv:2507.15876 (CTA trend factors) confirms medium-term 6-12m horizon dominance but does not address skip-month. H277 NASDAQ parallel remains the best academic parallel.
